thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 01/18/2019: CASA, BABA, TEAM, BIDU, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 01/18/2019: CASA, BABA, TEAM, BIDU, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.78%
AAPL: +0.78%
IBM: +0.51%
CSCO: +0.48%
GOOG: Flat
Tech stocks were edging higher pre-market Friday.
Stocks moving on news include:
(-) Casa Systems ( CASA ), which was sinking more than 28% after the company provided its preliminary financial results for Q4, which would fall short of analysts' expectations, and lowered its guidance for fiscal 2018 below Street estimates. The provider of converged broadband infrastructure technology solutions sees non-GAAP earnings of $0.13 - $0.17 per diluted share.
(+) Atlassian ( TEAM ) was advancing by more than 8% as i t report ed fiscal Q2 earnings of $0.25 on a non IFRS per share basis, up from $0.13 a year ago and ahead of the consensus on Capital IQ for $0.21 a share.
In other sector news:
(+) Baidu ( BIDU ) was up over 1% after the South China Morning Post reported that the company is partnering with China Central Television to promote its flagship mobile app which is lagging behind competitors Alibaba ( BABA ) and Tencent.
